text:
The 60-second cut running 0–60s is doing the right job as a highlight. It plays as a complete arc: the intro banter and setup ("Jake, meeting at the bottom of this cliff... I'll try to follow if I don't"), the sudden reaction ("Oh, God."), the silent POV run down the slope, the check-in ("You okay?"), and the reassurance ("I'll try to follow you later"). The frame at 3s confirms the group shot at the top with boards and skis, and the frame at 40s confirms clean, unbroken descent footage during the quiet stretch — no dead air or broken frames.

Critically, the clip ends exactly on a completed sentence: the transcript shows "later." finishing precisely at the 60.00s mark, so the cut lands clean with no mid-sentence truncation. Everything past this point in the source is the same phrase looping verbatim for another eight-plus minutes with no new content, so there's no better 60-second alternative to pull from elsewhere in the recording — this stretch is where all the distinct, meaningful material lives.

The highlight clip is set: a single trimmed 60-second selection (0–60s) with intact audio, a real narrative shape, and a sentence-safe out point. No captions or transitions were requested, so none were added. This has been visually spot-checked at two points in the timeline and reads correctly.
